definitions.RGB: strict fixed eight-frame category canonical-linear MSE, separately balanced across four sampler groups
definitions.mixed_total: fixed_objective_without_prior; includes protection/coverage/A20 terms, never labelled RGB MSE
definitions.r7_inside: effective local alpha target=1-frozen retained foreground alpha; fixed R7 inside/outside domains
definitions.A20_visibility: actual checkpoint source21 effective-alpha preservation; identity fixed by current source mapping

definitions.heldout: Eight non-training views are render-only; no heldout RGB ground-truth score is computed

preparation_receipt.offline_fragment_support: fixed 3D Gaussian offsets inside retained vehicle boxes or outside all eight road support frusta

frozen_fragments.representation: offline fixed 3D Gaussian fragments; one native raster; no per-view image gate

source_native_freeze.source: native load receipts plus per-step base.assert_fixed; checkpoint parameters are not optimizer groups
